intro: Near the Jansen Stead, Farmer Furlbrow and his wife are stranded beside their broken wagon. Driven from their northern Westfall farm by the Defias Brotherhood, they hope to reach Elwynn Forest.

sections.t: A Life Packed on a Wagon
p: Theodore Furlbrow left his pumpkin patch in northern Westfall with his wife, Verna, as criminals drove them from their home. They salvaged what they could and set out for Elwynn Forest, urging neighbors such as Farmer Saldean to leave too. Near the Jansen Stead, their wagon broke down, leaving them exposed to bandits and wild beasts. Verna tends to their horse, Old Blanchy, while Theodore keeps watch over the road. He hopes to recover the pocket watch Verna's father gave him on their wedding day and warn Sentinel Hill about the approaching bandits.
